_source: OSRS Wiki shop and owner pages: each shop below won't trade, and each 'stock' item isn't sold, until the quest is complete ('started': once it is started). 'carrying' is an item the player must hold in the inventory or worn. Quests are matched by name through quest:is-complete / quest:is-started; a quest this server doesn't have leaves the shop open.
_messages: Refusals are the Wiki's own lines (Transcript:<NPC>, 'Trying to trade'): 'npc' says 'lines', then 'statement' shows in a box; 'message' is a game message. A shop with neither gets the 'fallback' message, which is ours.
fallback: You need to complete {quest} to trade here.
fallbackStarted: You need to start {quest} to trade here.
